```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  eval = FALSE,
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

```{r setup}
# For vignette demonstration, ensure 'histopathology' is available.
if (!exists("histopathology")) {
  set.seed(123)
  histopathology <- data.frame(
    LVI = factor(sample(c("Present", "Absent", NA), 150, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.1))),
    PNI = factor(sample(c("Present", "Absent"), 150, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.2, 0.8))),
    PreinvasiveComponent = factor(sample(c("Yes", "No"), 150, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.6)))
  )
}
head(histopathology)
```


```{r}
library(ClinicoPathDescriptives)
# data(histopathology, package="ClinicoPathDescriptives") # if needed

# venn() accepts up to seven variables. Each `varNtrue` is a Level option, which
# jamovi never gives a default, so every one of var1true ... var7true is a
# REQUIRED argument of the R wrapper - pass NULL for the slots you do not use.
# show_ggvenn is TRUE by default; the UpSet plot needs show_upsetR = TRUE.
results_venn <- venn(
  data = histopathology,
  var1 = "LVI",
  var1true = "Present",
  var2 = "PNI",
  var2true = "Present",
  var3 = "PreinvasiveComponent",
  var3true = "Yes",
  var4 = NULL, var4true = NULL,
  var5 = NULL, var5true = NULL,
  var6 = NULL, var6true = NULL,
  var7 = NULL, var7true = NULL,
  show_ggvenn = TRUE,
  show_upsetR = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
# Venn diagram (ggvenn engine)
results_venn$plotGgvenn
```



```{r}
# UpSet plot (requires show_upsetR = TRUE above)
results_venn$plotUpsetR
```
